scenario: LRST.1.5.1 — an interpolated `as` correlation's bindings inherit LRST.1.5: a Json sub-path segment can soft-fail if the path is missing, so it is rejected (DS_VALIDATE_AS_SOFTFAIL_EXPRESSION) even though a general interpolation would compile (null → ""). A correlation key must be non-soft-failing so per-fact identity is well defined. Pin: `as "rsvp-{r.maybe.field}"` where `r.maybe` is Json.
rules_ds:
service svc.do:
    kwarg line: String
    no response

schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    maybe: Json mutable

rule trig:
    Req r
->
    call svc.do line: "x" nocooldown as "rsvp-{r.maybe.field}"
